source_name: Finweek Bratislava - Slovak fintech & banking conference
why_relevant: The most on-target SK event for this cell: dedicated fintech/banking conference (10th edition Oct 2026) with an explicit partners page naming tiered commercial sponsors (Visa, Thunes, CRIF, Decta, Fumbi), institutional patrons (MF SR, NBS) and an expo partner tier. Speaker roster maps who from which bank/vendor is publicly positioning. Directly reveals who is selling into SK banking.

source_name: Zlatá minca - Slovak financial products award (nominations & results)
why_relevant: Running since 2005, ~210-member expert jury; publishes per-year NOMINATION lists (not just winners) by product category across banks, insurers, fintechs. Nomination lists are the shortlist signal the cell targets: which vendor-built products banks choose to push. Also a Finweek side-event partner, linking the awards and conference circuits.

source_name: ZBK - Združenie pre bankové karty (event & training calendar)
why_relevant: The only SK body uniting banks, non-bank entities, payment institutions and 'technology partners' around cards. Its seminar/conference calendar (card issuing, card acceptance, payment security, 'Trendy v digitálnych platbách', 'Deň bez hotovosti') is where card-tech vendors present; speaker lists and event partners identify active payment-infrastructure sellers. Also republishes Mastercard Awards results.

source_name: Mastercard Awards Slovensko (scheme-run award) - via Forbes SK
why_relevant: Scheme-run annual award naming specific bank projects in payments/digitalisation/sustainability (e.g. mBank smart payment ring, UniCredit portfolio migration to Mastercard, VÚB cashback card, ČSOB anti-fraud campaign). Each citation is effectively a mini case study identifying a deployed product and, by implication, its technology supplier. Forbes SK is the publication partner, so results are archived year by year.

source_name: TREND Top Banka roka / TREND business awards
why_relevant: TREND's 'Banka roka' and annual best-company awards are the highest-profile SK financial ranking; banks reliably press-release the result (VÚB 2025, SLSP 2022), and the associated award gala has commercial partners. Useful for reputational ranking of the bank buyer set rather than vendor identification.

source_name: Slovenská Fintech Asociácia - events and member roster
why_relevant: Association events page plus a public member list (/clenovia/) — a ready-made actor map of SK fintech vendors, and the organiser side of several conferences. Bi-monthly member meetups in Bratislava indicate an ongoing event stream worth monitoring for who joins.

source_name: FINAS - Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia
why_relevant: Second SK fintech/insurtech association; co-organises FinTech Roadmap with the Czech associations and appears as a Finweek side-events partner. Membership and event co-branding reveal cross-border CZ/SK vendor alignments.

source_name: FinTech Roadmap (CZ/SK joint fintech conference, ČNB Prague)
why_relevant: CZ-SK joint conference co-organised with SK's FINAS; 2026 edition sold out with 400+ attendees and 40+ speakers at the Czech National Bank. Panels explicitly pair vendors with banks (e.g. Visa, MoroSystems, Raiffeisenbank, IDEMIA Secure Transactions on one panel) — a direct read on who is co-selling into CEE banking. CEE-relevant for a SK cell because SK vendors and banks participate.

source_name: MoneyFest Bratislava - financial professionals conference
why_relevant: Largest independent SK financial conference (2026: 29 Sep, x-bionic sphere Šamorín) with explicit named partner tiers — generálny partner Generali, generálny produktový partner Porsche Slovensko, generálny mediálny partner FinReport, hlavní partneri Finportal, ARTS, Penta Fund. Skewed to distribution/insurance/investment rather than banking technology, but maps the intermediary channel and its sponsors.

source_name: Qubit Conference Slovakia (cyber security, Low Tatras / Košice)
why_relevant: 18 editions, B2B cyber-security event whose audience is explicitly CISOs from finance among other verticals; SK edition 11-12 Nov 2026. The programme is advertised as 'vendor-free', which means the commercial signal sits in the sponsor/partner tiers rather than the agenda — precisely the paid-declaration signal this cell wants for security vendors selling into SK banks.

source_name: 'IT vo finančníctve' conference (banks/insurers IT conference, Bratislava)
why_relevant: Narrowly targeted at IT in banks, insurers and financial institutions — the single most on-topic SK agenda for banking technology procurement (fintech, cybersecurity, data analytics, legal aspects of new tech). Speaker and partner lists here are close to a shortlist of active SK banking-IT vendors.

source_name: konferencie.sk / Education.sk - Slovak conference aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator that lists SK professional conferences with dates, organisers and topic tags. The cheapest way to discover small, low-visibility banking/payments/IT events that never surface in search — the classic weak-signal harvesting layer for this cell.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia - Corporate Banking Forum ('Fórum korporátneho bankovníctva')
why_relevant: 20-year-running corporate banking forum organised by the American Chamber of Commerce in Slovakia with named event partners; brings together bank leaders, law firms, investors. Partner tiers reveal professional-services and technology firms buying access to SK corporate banking decision-makers.

source_name: NBS - Národná banka Slovenska: conferences and events
why_relevant: Central bank event calendar. NBS both hosts events and lends institutional patronage/speakers to commercial conferences (e.g. Finweek). Its programmes indicate which regulatory topics (instant payments, digital euro, DORA) will drive SK bank spending in the following 12-18 months — the timing input that makes sponsor signals interpretable.

source_name: SBA - Slovenská banková asociácia (news, projects & standards)
why_relevant: Sole SK bank interest body, with a payment-cards commission and a projects/standards page. Announcements of joint sector projects and working groups name the participating technology partners; SBA also lends its name to conference programmes. Pointer to the events and standards where vendors are engaged.

source_name: FinReport.sk - 'Podujatia' vertical (SK financial event journalism)
why_relevant: Specialist SK financial outlet with a dedicated events section; acts as media partner to Finweek and MoneyFest and therefore publishes speaker line-ups, partner names and post-event recaps that often outlive the event site itself. Best fallback when conference sites take down past editions.

source_name: Startitup.sk / Nextech.sk - SK tech media conference recaps
why_relevant: Both act as media partners to SK fintech events and publish detailed pre- and post-event pieces listing panels, speakers and partners (Finweek 2023/2024, AmCham Corporate Banking Forum). Serves as an archive layer for rosters that vanish from event sites between editions.

source_name: Finparáda - 'Finančný produkt roka' (SK product-of-the-year award)
why_relevant: Independent comparison portal running its own annual financial-product award with per-category scoring across SK banks (SLSP, Fio, UniCredit, mBank in 2024). A second, methodologically distinct product shortlist to triangulate against Zlatá minca.

source_name: Banky.sk - SK banking news portal (awards & event coverage)
why_relevant: Consumer/trade banking portal that consistently republishes SK award results (Zlatá minca, Mastercard Awards 2025) in full, free of paywall. Cheap, stable secondary capture point for award shortlists.

source_name: Global Finance / Euromoney SK country awards (as republished by SK banks)
why_relevant: International award bodies issue Slovakia-specific titles (Best Bank, Best Digital Bank, Most Innovative Digital Bank in Slovakia). SK banks press-release these in detail, often naming the underlying digital platform or project — a route into vendor identification and into how banks position their tech externally.

source_name: Hospodarske noviny online (HNonline.sk) / Finweb
why_relevant: Daily business paper; Finweb section is the standing SK banking/finance news stream — rate moves, branch and ATM network changes, bank IT outages, management changes, bank levy politics. Frequently names suppliers in project stories.

source_name: Dennik E (economic desk of Dennik N)
why_relevant: Confirmed live economic vertical with substantive banking interviews (e.g. bank executives, Tatra banka economists) and critical business reporting. Good for executive moves, strategy commentary and named-source interviews about digitalisation.

source_name: Forbes Slovensko
why_relevant: Confirmed SK edition publishing banker interviews on digitalisation and AI (e.g. 'Bankar Zatko: Banky sa menia na IT firmy'). Strong for strategy narrative, fintech founders, and partnership announcements framed as interviews.

source_name: Zive.sk (Slovak IT/tech news daily)
why_relevant: Largest SK consumer-tech newsroom; covers mobile banking app releases, outages, Apple/Google Pay rollouts, instant payments, digital ID and bank IT failures. Often first to report a bank service incident and to test new banking apps.

source_name: TOUCHIT.sk (technology magazine)
why_relevant: Has a dedicated 'banky' tag and publishes vendor-friendly deep dives on Slovak digital banking (365.bank launch, mobile-banking usage data, commentary on regulatory barriers to digitalisation). Useful for product launches and vendor positioning.

source_name: ITnews.sk (business IT magazine)
why_relevant: B2B IT title covering enterprise projects, integrators and implementations in SK; the natural place for core-banking, data-centre, cybersecurity and outsourcing project reporting where the integrator is named.

source_name: Finsider.sk
why_relevant: Confirmed active SK finance newsroom with granular retail-banking operational coverage — branch closures/holidays, deposit machines (vkladomaty) interoperability, accessibility retrofits, ATM network changes. Exactly the operational-change signal the cell targets.

source_name: oPeniazoch.sk (Zoznam.sk personal-finance portal)
why_relevant: Long-running personal-finance portal with a dedicated Banky category and a very deep archive (pagination observed into the 8000s), making it an unusually good longitudinal archive of SK bank announcements and product/fee changes.
